## Aberdeen v Falkirk: mid-table momentum meets recovery push

Aberdeen and Falkirk meet in the Scottish Premiership at Pittodrie Stadium on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, with one point between the sides in a tight mid-table pack.

Aberdeen have not beaten Falkirk in their last three league meetings, with the visitors winning twice and drawing once across 2025-26. [...] The game could hinge on contrasting routes to goal. The Dons have attempted 90 shots with 36.67% shooting accuracy, while The Bairns have taken 79 at a sharper 48.1%. The Dons have conceded three penalties this season, The Bairns have yet to concede one.

The Dons start 9th on 11 points and could leapfrog their visitors with a win. The Bairns sit 7th on 12 and would move to 15 with victory, strengthening their push towards the top half.
